criteria.rationale: All shipment weights, carrier selections, costs, industry benchmarks, and savings calculations match the source records and respect the operative approval hierarchy. Specifically, the deliverable applies the approved Revision 2 freight flat rate of USD 150 from record-17.txt (which registry.txt designates as in force) rather than the unapproved Revision 3 draft rate of USD 110 found in record-22.txt, working-notes.txt, and Shipping parameters.xlsx. Missing data such as the processing date and carrier tracking numbers are left uninvented and explicitly documented as unconfirmed.
